parallels.note: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness…

translations.web: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
translations.bsb: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
translations.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
translations.asv: Look therefore whether the light that is in thee be not darkness.
